claims.claim: Fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was $9.9B; combined QCT Automotive and IoT revenue grew 28% YoY and Automotive posted a 23rd consecutive quarter of double-digit YoY growth.
Qualcomm completed the Modular acquisition to create an open software foundation for generative and agentic AI, while management targets non-handset revenue of $40B by FY2029.

risks.risk: Memory/supply constraints and continued handset exposure can offset diversification gains.

unknowns.unknown: The durability and margin profile of the new data-center/custom-silicon ramp remains unproven in this artifact.

claims.claim: Diversification execution is visible in 28% YoY combined Automotive/IoT growth and sustained Automotive growth, reducing reliance on the handset cycle at the margin.
The FY2029 non-handset target creates a measurable execution hurdle; evidence should track data-center shipments, automotive conversion and IoT growth against that target.

risks.risk: Diversification targets can disappoint if custom silicon or automotive programs slip while handset concentration remains material.

unknowns.unknown: Current valuation and segment-level incremental margins are not established here.
